answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a signed remote-attestation report whose enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, identifies approved code and configuration. A verifier rejects duplicates unless every instance presents fresh hardware-backed evidence; copying keys, a VM, or a timber image cannot reproduce the measurement’s trusted platform binding. Thus Sybil scaling requires purchasing physical silicon and provisioning new attested enclaves, not cloning software across the horizon or into a nebula.
